secure_path.description: The PATH used for command execution when running sudo.

sudo_groups.description: List of sudo-enabled groups; each group defines access scope and commands

include_sudoers_d.description: If true, include additional sudo configurations from /etc/sudoers.d (recommended for modularity)

enable_passwd_prompt.description: If true, users must enter their password when invoking sudo; disable only in secure, ephemeral, or containerized environments

enable_logging.description: If true, log all sudo commands and session I/O to /var/log/sudo.log (use for audit compliance)
